verdict: Revenue is holding, but ad efficiency softened this week and needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,788.78 in revenue on $1,421.47 in spend — a 4.07 return on ad spend (ROAS) — with 34 purchases completed. That top-line number is intact, but efficiency slipped: ROAS fell 25.8% compared to the prior 7-day period, driven largely by your top campaign carrying 55% of total spend while purchase volume softened. Ad creative is being reviewed and budget concentration is being rebalanced to spread risk across campaigns. Purchase-signal tracking is also being repaired, which means revenue figures may under-report slightly until that fix is confirmed — expect a cleaner read next period.
